message.content: On April 10th, 2026, during their discussion, WolfgangSchulz and LiHua decided to explore the song "Stand By Me" for their jam session. They mentioned that it had a nice groove and that they could all participate in playing it together, indicating their enthusiasm for the potential collaboration. YurikoYamamoto also expressed her excitement for trying out this classic song, further emphasizing its importance in their upcoming jam session.
